blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Barrett's esophagus dysplasia grading suffers substantial inter-observer variability, particularly for low-grade dysplasia, complicating clinical decision-making. We conducted a retrospective multi-institutional diagnostic accuracy study of a foundation model-based deep learning system for dysplasia grading, using 969 H\&E-stained whole slide images from four institutions. Patch-level classifiers trained on expert annotations identified diagnostically relevant regions, followed by attribute-aware multiple instance learning for slide-level classification as non-dysplastic Barrett's esophagus (NDBE), low-grade dysplasia, or high-grade dysplasia. On a held-out test set (n = 130), macro-averaged AUC was 0.96 (95\% CI 0.93--0.98). For binary dysplasia detection, sensitivity was 98\% (80/82) and specificity 81\% (39/48), with a negative likelihood ratio of 0.030 and quadratic-weighted \kap{} of 0.83 against expert consensus. No high-grade dysplasia case was misclassified as NDBE. Performance was consistent across institutions without stain normalization, indicating that stain-robust foundation-model representations may remove the site-specific preprocessing that has constrained prior systems to institution-specific deployment.
blocks.zh: 巴雷特的食道性血压分级在观测者间发生很大变化,特别是在低级血压中,使临床决策复杂化. 我们利用来自四个机构的969个HQQE覆盖的全幻灯片图像,对基于底模的深层学习系统进行了多机构诊断准确性研究。 接受过专家说明培训的补丁级分类员确定了诊断相关区域,然后是属性意识多例学习,用于滑行级分类,分为非弹性巴雷特食道(NDBE),低级血压,或高级血压. 在停产试验(n=130)中,宏观平均AUC为0.96(95\%CI 0.93-0.98)。 对于二进制的dysplasia检测,灵敏度为98\%(80/82),特异性为81\%(39/48),负概率比为0.030,四重式\kap{}为0.83,与专家协商一致. 没有高等级的dysplasia案件被误称为NDBE. 各机构的业绩始终如一,没有出现污点正常化,这表明污点模糊的基建模型表示方式可能会消除特定地点的预处理方式,这种预处理方式使先前的系统受到特定机构部署的限制。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Barrett’s esophagus (BE) affects approximately 1-3% of the general population in the United States [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] and represents the primary precursor lesion to esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAC), with annual progression rates ranging from 0.3% per year for non-dysplastic Barrett’s esophagus to 28.6% for high-grade dysplasia [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Dysplasia grading determines clinical management: non-dysplastic cases require surveillance every 3-5 years, low-grade dysplasia prompts either annual surveillance or endoscopic eradication therapy, and high-grade dysplasia necessitates endoscopic eradication therapy [ 8 ] . However, substantial inter-observer variability in dysplasia grading complicates clinical decision-making [ 9 ] . Among expert gastrointestinal pathologists, agreement is substantial for high-grade dysplasia ( κ \kappa = 0.71) and non-dysplastic Barrett’s esophagus ( κ \kappa = 0.79) but falls to fair or poor levels for low-grade dysplasia ( κ \kappa = 0.42) [ 10 , 11 ] . Community pathologists demonstrate even lower concordance with expert consensus, with documented tendency toward dysplasia overdiagnosis [ 12 ] . This variability leads to unnecessary referrals, patient anxiety, and potentially inappropriate interventions.
blocks.zh: 巴雷特的食道(BE)影响着大约1-3 %的美国普通人口[1,2,3],并且代表了食道腺瘤(EAC)的主要先发体损伤,非发性巴雷特的食道的年进取率从每年0.3%到高血压的28.6%[4,5,6,7]不等. Dysplasia分级决定了临床管理:非弹性病需要每3至5年监测一次,低等性病需要每年监测一次或内视根除疗法,而高等性病需要内视根除疗法[8]。 然而,观测者间在血压分级方面的巨大差异使临床决策复杂化[9]. 在胃肠道病理学专家中,对于高等血压(κ克帕 = 0.71)与非血压巴雷特的食道(κ克帕 = 0.79)有相当的一致,但对于低等血压(κ克帕 = 0.42)则降到了公平或差的水平 [10,11]. 社区病理学家表现出与专家共识的更低调的一致,有文献记载的出现过量诊断的痢疾倾向[12]. 这种可变性导致不必要的转诊、病人的焦虑和潜在的不当干预。

blocks.en: Recent applications of deep learning to Barrett’s esophagus dysplasia classification have shown promising results [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . Prior work from our group demonstrated the feasibility of deep learning for BE dysplasia grading [ 13 ] ; however, external validation across institutions [ 15 ] required institution-specific stain normalization models to account for differences in tissue processing and scanner protocols, an approach that is impractical for broad deployment across diverse pathology laboratories. The emergence of foundation models in computational pathology addresses this limitation directly, providing stain-robust pre-trained representations that generalize across institutions without site-specific adaptation [ 17 , 18 ] . Despite these advances, multi-institutional training approaches combining foundation models with clinical utility evaluation for community practice settings remain underexplored.
blocks.zh: 最近对巴雷特的食道干燥分类进行深层学习的应用已经显示出有希望的结果[13、14、15、16]。 我们小组先前的工作表明,深入学习BE dysplasia分级[13]是可行的;然而,各机构的外部验证[15]需要针对具体机构的污点正常化模式,以考虑到组织处理和扫描仪协议方面的差异,这种办法对于在各种病理学实验室进行广泛部署是不切实际的。 计算病理学中的基础模型的出现直接解决了这一局限性,提供了污渍活性预加训练的表述,在不进行特定地点调整的情况下,将各机构普遍化[17,18]. 尽管取得了这些进展,但将基础模型与社区实践环境临床实用性评价相结合的多机构培训方法仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en: We aimed to develop a foundation model-based deep learning system for Barrett’s esophagus dysplasia grading using a multi-institutional training and validation dataset. The system employs a two-stage architecture: patch-level classifiers trained on expert annotations identify diagnostically relevant regions, followed by attribute-aware multiple instance learning for slide-level classification [ 19 ] . We evaluated the system’s performance across institutions, characterized clinical utility metrics including likelihood ratios for dysplasia detection, and analyzed error patterns to assess safety for potential clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是利用多机构培训和验证数据集,为巴雷特的食道分级开发一个基于基础模型的深层学习系统。 该系统采用分两个阶段的架构:经过专家说明培训的补丁级分类员确定诊断相关区域,然后进行属性意识多实例学习,用于幻灯片级分类[19]. 我们评价了该系统跨机构的性能,确定了临床实用度量,包括检测发作的可能性比率,并分析了误差模式,以评估潜在临床部署的安全性。

blocks.en: Ethics declaration

blocks.en: This study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and was approved by the Mayo Clinic Institutional Review Board (approval no. 23-009891). Because the study involved retrospective analysis of existing pathology data and posed no more than minimal risk, the Mayo Clinic Institutional Review Board waived the requirement for informed consent and for HIPAA authorization.

blocks.en: Dataset
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: This retrospective study utilized a multi-institutional dataset comprising 969 Barrett’s esophagus (BE) slides from 961 patients across four centers: Mayo Clinic (n = 531), Baylor Dallas (n = 169), Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU) (n = 151), and University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) (n = 118). BE diagnosis was confirmed through review of endoscopic and histologic reports. Inclusion criteria were: (1) endoscopic evidence of BE ( ≥ \geq 1 cm columnar mucosa extending proximally from the gastroesophageal junction), and (2) confirmed histologic diagnosis of BE (intestinal-type mucosa with goblet cells). Individual patients could contribute multiple slides from different specimens obtained during the same or different procedures, but not from multiple levels (serial sections) of a single specimen. The highest grade of dysplasia on each slide, as confirmed by consensus among expert study pathologists, was used for classification. Patient demographics and endoscopic findings by institution are summarized in Table S1 .

blocks.en: Two expert pathologists (CH, JL) with significant BE dysplasia experience independently reviewed all slides to confirm dysplasia grade based on established criteria [ 20 , 21 ] . Discordant cases were resolved through discussion between reviewers, with the consensus read serving as the final label. Slides were classified as non-dysplastic BE (NDBE), low-grade dysplasia (LGD), or high-grade dysplasia (HGD). Mayo Clinic slides were annotated for regions with the highest dysplasia grade using Aperio ImageScope software (Leica Biosystems), as previously described [ 13 ] . Slides from non-Mayo institutions lacked patch-level annotations and contributed slide-level dysplasia grade labels only.

blocks.en: Preprocessing pipeline
blocks.zh: 预处理管道

blocks.en: Whole slide images scanned at 40 × \times magnification were preprocessed to extract 1280 × \times 1280 pixel tissue patches using a grid-based tiling approach with 50% overlap between adjacent tiles. This patch size was chosen empirically so that individual glandular tissues of the specimen would fit into a single patch. Tissue segmentation was performed using HSV color space thresholding, where background regions were identified when pixels met either: (1) brightness > > 240 or < < 30 combined with saturation < < 76, or (2) brightness > > 200 with saturation < < 45. Tiles containing ≥ \geq 5% tissue were retained for analysis to ensure comprehensive tissue inclusion.

blocks.en: Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: 特征提取

blocks.en: Features were extracted from each patch using Midnight-12k [ 22 ] , a pathology-specific foundation model. Midnight is a self-supervised vision transformer trained on over 12,000 whole slide images using the DINOv2 framework, demonstrating robust performance in tissue classification and cancer detection tasks without requiring manual annotations.

blocks.en: Model Framework
blocks.zh: 示范框架

blocks.en: The classification framework consisted of two sequential stages ( Figure 1 ). Stage 1 employed patch-level classifiers to identify diagnostically relevant tissue regions and select informative patches for each slide. Stage 2 utilized a multiple instance learning (MIL) architecture to generate slide-level predictions from the sampled patches.
blocks.zh: 分类框架包括两个相继阶段(图1)。 第一阶段使用补丁级分级器,以识别诊断相关的组织区域,并为每张幻灯片选择信息补丁. 第2阶段利用了多实例学习(MIL)架构,从被采样的补丁中生成幻灯片级预测.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Two-stage deep learning framework for Barrett’s esophagus dysplasia grading. (a) Stage 1: Patch-level classifier. Annotated Mayo Clinic slides were tiled into overlapping patches, embedded using the frozen Midnight-12k foundation model, and classified by four MLP classifiers (NDBE, dysplasia, LGD, HGD vs. all) to assign each patch a final category. (b) Stage 2: Slide-level classifier. Patches from each whole-slide image were embedded and scored by the frozen Stage 1 classifiers, then sampled into a 1000-patch bag per slide using a pre-specified class distribution. The bag was input to AttriMIL, which computes class-specific attention (A) and instance-level scores (P) to generate attribute scores (S), aggregated and passed through softmax to yield the final slide-level prediction (NDBE, LGD, or HGD).Snowflakes denote frozen components (weights held fixed, not updated during training); flames denote trainable components (weights updated during training) BE: Barrett’s esophagus; NDBE: non-dysplastic BE; LGD: low-grade dysplasia; HGD: high-grade dysplasia; MIL: multiple instance learning; MLP: Multilayer Perceptron

blocks.en: Each classifier was a small neural network (a two-layer multilayer perceptron) that learns to weigh combinations of the extracted image features and output a probability for each patch category; standard training techniques (ReLU activation, batch normalization, and dropout) were used to stabilize learning and reduce overfitting. Patches were assigned final classifications based on the four classifier outputs, as summarized in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 每个分级器是一个小神经网络(一个双层多层受体),学习对所提取图像特征的组合进行权衡,并输出出每个补丁类别的概率;标准训练技术(ReLU活化,分批常态,和辍学)被用来稳定学习并减少过度适应. 如表1所概述,补丁是根据四个分类器产出分配的最后分类。

blocks.en: The dysplasia classifier was included to reduce false positives in LGD and HGD classifiers, which occasionally misclassified artifacts or high-cellularity non-glandular regions as dysplastic tissue.
blocks.zh: 将血吸虫分级法列入LGD和HGD分级法是为了减少假阳性,这些分类法偶尔会将文物或高细胞非腺体区域误归类为血吸虫组织.

blocks.en: Table 1: Patch classification criteria based on binary classifier outputs. ‘ ✓ \checkmark ’ indicates a positive classifier prediction. Discrepancy categories reflect conflicting classifier outputs. NDBE: Non-dysplastic Barrett’s Esophagus; LGD: Low-grade Dysplasia; HGD: High-grade Dysplasia
blocks.zh: 表1:基于二进制分类器输出的补丁分类标准. ``\checkmark ' 表示积极的分类预测。 差异类别反映了相互冲突的分类器产出。 NDBE:非弹性 巴雷特的食道; LGD:低级 Dysplasia; HGD:高级 Dysplasia

blocks.en: Patch Sampling Strategy
blocks.zh: 补丁取样战略

blocks.en: For Stage 2 MIL training, a priority-based sampling strategy selected up to 1000 patches per slide to form a “bag,” the fixed-size collection of patches used to represent that slide during classification. Patches were first categorized into six groups: NDBE, LGD, HGD, and three discrepancy categories (LGD-HGD, LGD-NDBE, HGD-NDBE) ( Table 1 ). Spatial redundancy was removed by identifying duplicates in 3 × \times 3 neighborhoods; when multiple neighboring patches belonged to the same category, only the patch with highest prediction probability was retained. Patches were sorted by prediction probability, with non-duplicate patches prioritized to ensure spatial diversity.
blocks.zh: 阶段 2 MIL培训,一种基于优先的取样策略,每张幻灯片选择最多可达1000个补丁,形成一个“包”,即分类时用来代表该幻灯片的固定大小补丁集合。 补丁首先被分为6个类别:NDBE、LGD、HGD和3个差异类别(LGD-HGD、LGD-NDBE、HGD-NDBE)(表1)。 空间冗余通过在 3×\times 3 个街区中识别重复而去除;当多个相邻的补丁属于同一类时,只保留了预测概率最高的补丁. 补丁按预测概率排序,不重复补丁优先,以确保空间多样性。

blocks.en: Bags were constructed with the following composition: 20% NDBE, 35% LGD, 30% HGD, 7.5% LGD-HGD discrepancy, and 7.5% LGD-NDBE discrepancy. NDBE-HGD discrepancy patches were excluded as they typically represented model errors or artifacts. For each category, candidate pools were created by oversampling at 1.1 × \times the target number, from which the exact target was randomly drawn to introduce training variability. When slides had insufficient patches in a category, deficits were filled from combined discrepancy categories or neighboring diagnostic categories following a predefined priority order (HGD filled from LGD, then NDBE). Remaining positions were padded with null embeddings randomly selected from background tissue patches to maintain the 1000-patch bag size and improve model robustness to non-tissue regions. Final bags were shuffled before input to prevent positional bias.
blocks.zh: 袋装的成分如下:20%的NDBE、35%LGD、30%HGD、7.5%LGD-HGD差异和7.5%LGD-NDBE差异。 不包括NDBE-HGD差异补丁,因为这些补丁通常代表模型错误或文物。 对于每个类别,通过在1.1×x\x分时对目标数进行过度抽样来创建候选人人才库,从中随机抽取准确的目标,引入培训可变性. 当幻灯片在一个类别中补丁不足时,会按照预先确定的优先级顺序(HGD由LGD填充,再由NDBE填充),通过合并差异类别或相邻诊断类别来填充赤字. 其余位置被从背景组织补丁中随机选取的无嵌入物所添加,以保持1000平方公尺的袋大小并改进模型稳健度到非组织区域. 最后袋被洗后再输入,以防止位置偏差.

blocks.en: Stage 2: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) Architecture
blocks.zh: 第二阶段:多实例学习结构

blocks.en: The Stage 2 model employed AttriMIL [ 19 ] , an MIL framework in which the algorithm learns which patches in a slide’s bag are most diagnostically informative for each grade, similar to a pathologist scanning a slide and focusing on the most relevant regions, rather than weighing every patch equally. AttriMIL scores each patch’s relevance to NDBE, LGD, and HGD separately (class-specific attention) and combines this with a per-patch prediction (instance classifier) into a combined “attribute score” for each class, which is aggregated across the bag to produce the final slide-level diagnosis.
blocks.zh: “第二阶段”模型采用了AttriMIL [19],这是一个MIL框架,其中算法在幻灯片袋中学习补丁,对于每个年级来说,最具有诊断性的信息,类似于病理学家扫描幻灯片并注重最相关的区域,而不是对每个补丁进行同等的权衡。 AttriMIL 将每个补丁与NDBE,LGD,和HGD的关联性分别评分(具体类别注意),并将此与每个分数的预测(内分数分类器)结合为每个分数的合并"属性分数",该分数在包中相接,以产生最终的滑行级诊断.

blocks.en: Training Details
blocks.zh: 培训详情

blocks.en: Models were trained using the AdamW optimizer with learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} and weight decay 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} . Training proceeded for 400 epochs with early stopping (patience = 40 epochs) using distributed data parallel strategy across four A100 GPUs via PyTorch. The best model checkpoint was selected based on validation macro-average F1 score.
blocks.zh: 使用 AdamW 优化器进行模型培训,学习率为 1×10−5 1\times 10×5}体重衰减为 3×10−4 3\times 10×4}。 利用通过PyTorch的4个A100GPU的分布式数据并行战略,对400个早期停止(patience = 40 epocs)的时代进行了培训。 根据验证宏平均值F1分数选择出最佳模式检查站.

blocks.en: Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 统计分析

blocks.en: Performance metrics (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, F1 score, and accuracy) were reported with 95% confidence intervals computed via bootstrap resampling (n = 1000 iterations, random seed=42). Macro-averaged AUC was computed as the unweighted mean of per-class one-versus-rest AUC values.
blocks.zh: 性能指标(接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)、灵敏度、特异性、F1分数和准确度)是通过靴子重新取样计算的95%的置信间隔(n = 1 000个迭代,随机种子=42个)。 宏观平均AUC被计算为每类AUC值的未加权平均值。

blocks.en: Agreement between model predictions and expert pathologist consensus with categories for dysplasia grading (NDBE, LGD, and HGD) was assessed using Cohen’s κ \kappa with unweighted and quadratic weighted schemes, with quadratic weighting selected as the primary measure to appropriately penalize non-adjacent errors in ordinal dysplasia grades. Per-class κ \kappa was calculated using one-versus-rest binarization for each grade, with an additional binary κ \kappa computed for distinguishing any dysplasia (LGD+HGD) from NDBE. Kappa values were interpreted as none (0.00-0.20), minimal (0.21-0.40), weak (0.41-0.60), moderate (0.61-0.80), or strong (0.81-0.90), and almost perfect agreement (above 0.90) [ 23 ] . Clinical utility was assessed using positive and negative likelihood ratios (LR+/LR − - ) for binary dysplasia grade prediction. Cross-institutional consistency was assessed by comparing per-site accuracy using Fisher’s exact test and the predicted probability assigned to the true class using the Kruskal-Wallis test, the latter chosen because these values were not normally distributed and institutional group sizes were small and unequal. All statistical tests were two-tailed with significance threshold α \alpha = 0.05.
blocks.zh: 模型预测与专家病理学家共识之间关于血压分级的类别(NDBE、LGD和HGD)之间的一致,是使用Cohen的“\ kappa”(配有未加权和四重加权方案)进行的,选择了四重加权作为主要措施,以适当惩罚正常血压分级中不相接的错误。 计算每个等级的正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正方正 Kappa值被解释为零(0.00-0.20),最小值(0.21-0.40),弱值(0.41-0.60),中值(0.61-0.80),或强值(0.81-0.90),几乎完全一致(高于0.90)[23]. 临床效用评估采用正负概率比率(LR+/LR−-)进行二进制分级预测。 采用Fisher的精确测试比较了每个地点的准确性,用Kruskal-Wallis测试来评估了跨机构的一致性,后者的选择是因为这些数值通常不分布,而且机构组的大小小而不平等。 所有统计测试均为两尾并有意义阈值α-α=0.05.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 总体业绩

blocks.en: The test set comprised 130 slides with the following grade distribution: 48 NDBE (36.9%), 45 LGD (34.6%), and 37 HGD (28.5%) from four institutions. Overall performance metrics are presented in Table 2 . The model achieved strong discriminative performance across all three classes, with AUC ranging from 0.94 for LGD (the most diagnostically challenging category) to 0.97 for both NDBE and HGD, yielding a macro-averaged AUC of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.93, 0.98) and macro-averaged F1 of 0.85 (95% CI: 0.78, 0.91). LGD demonstrated the lowest F1 score (0.82; 95% CI: 0.72, 0.90), consistent with its known diagnostic difficulty. For binary dysplasia (LGD/HGD vs. NDBE) detection, sensitivity was 98% (80/82; 95% CI: 0.94, 1.00) and specificity was 81% (39/48; 95% CI: 0.70, 0.93). Per-class sensitivity was 89% (33/37; 95% CI: 0.78, 0.98) for HGD and 84% (38/45; 95% CI: 0.74, 0.94) for LGD. The model achieved a positive LR of 5.20 (95% CI: 3.23, 13.06) and negative LR of 0.030 (95% CI: 0.013, 0.078) for any dysplasia detection. At the dysplasia prevalence reported for index endoscopy in Barrett’s esophagus, approximately 13% to 17% [ 24 , 25 ] , a negative model prediction reduces the post-test probability to 0.5% to 0.6% and a positive prediction increases it to 44% to 51%; after a negative prediction it remains below 1.3% even at an assumed prevalence of 30%.
blocks.zh: 测试组包括130个幻灯片,分级如下:48个NDBE(36.9%)、45个LGD(34.6%)和37个HGD(28.5%)。 总体业绩计量见表2。 该模型在所有三个类别中都取得了强烈的差别性表现,LGD(诊断性最强的类别)的AUC从0.94到NDBE和HGD的0.97,得出了宏观平均AUC为0.96(95%CI:0.93,0.98)和宏观平均F1为0.85(95%CI:0.78,0.91)。 LGD显示F1得分最低(0.82;95% CI:0.72,0.90),与其已知的诊断困难一致. 对于二进制干燥(LGD/HGD vs. NDBE)检测,灵敏度为98%(80/82;95% CI:0.94,1.00),特异性为81%(39/48;95% CI:0.70,0.93). 每类敏感度为89%(33/37;95%CI:0.78;84%CI:0.74)。 该模型实现了阳性LR为5.20(95% CI:3.23,13.06),负性LR为0.030(95% CI:0.013,0.078),用于任何呼吸道衰竭检测. 在巴雷特食道的指数内分泌率报告为13到17 % [24,25] , 一个负模型预测将测试后的概率降低到0.5%到0.6%,一个正预测将其提升到44%到51%;在负预测之后,即使假设的流行率为30%,它仍然低于1.3 % 。

blocks.en: Model-Pathologist Agreement
blocks.zh: 模型-心理学家协定

blocks.en: The model demonstrated moderate to strong agreement with expert pathologist consensus, achieving quadratic weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.83 (95% CI: 0.72, 0.91) and unweighted κ \kappa of 0.77 (95% CI: 0.67, 0.86). Per-class κ \kappa values were consistently high: NDBE 0.81 (95% CI: 0.70, 0.92), LGD 0.72 (95% CI: 0.58, 0.83), and HGD 0.78 (95% CI: 0.65, 0.89). For binary dysplasia detection, κ \kappa was 0.81 (95% CI: 0.70, 0.92).
blocks.zh: 该模型显示出与专家病理学家共识的温和或强烈一致,实现了四重加权Cohen的克普克0.83 (95% CI:0.72,0.91)和未加权的克普克0.77 (95% CI:0.67,0.86). 每类克帕的数值一直很高:NDBE 0.81(95% CI:0.70,0.92),LGD 0.72(95% CI:0.58,0.83)和HGD 0.78(95% CI:0.65,0.89)。 对于二进制的dysplasia检测,\kappa为0.81(95% CI:0.70,0.92).

blocks.en: Exact agreement occurred in 84.6% of cases (110/130), with 85% of misclassifications (17/20) involving adjacent dysplasia grades ( Table 3 ). Of the 20 misclassified cases, 14 (70%) were upgraded and 6 (30%) were downgraded relative to expert consensus. Only three cases (2.3%) exhibited non-adjacent errors (NDBE ↔ \leftrightarrow HGD), and no HGD cases were misclassified as NDBE, reflecting a conservative classification bias that favors over-grading over under-grading.
blocks.zh: 84.6%的病例(110/130起)达成了确切协议,85%的错分类(17/20起)涉及相邻的血压等级(表3)。 在20起分类错误的案件中,有14起(70%)升级,6起(30%)与专家共识相比降级。 只有3个案例(2.3%)出现非相邻错误(NDBE QQ\\正右翼HGD),没有HGD案例被错误地归类为NDBE,反映出保守的分类偏好,偏向于分级过低.

Of the 20 discordant cases, 14 (10.8% of all cases) were overcalled (orange) and 6 (4.6%) were undercalled (red) relative to expert consensus. blocks.en: Cross-Institutional Performance
blocks.zh: 跨机构 业绩

blocks.en: Per-site macro-averaged AUC ranged from 0.94 to 0.96 with overlapping 95% confidence intervals, and all three grades were represented at every institution ( Table 4 ). Accuracy did not differ significantly across sites (Baylor 71%, Mayo 87%, OHSU 86%, UAB 89%; Fisher’s exact p = 0.34), nor did the predicted probability assigned to the true class (Kruskal-Wallis H = 2.82, p = 0.42). The lower F1 at Baylor (0.68; 95% CI 0.44, 0.88) reflects the small site sample (n = 21, with only 3 HGD cases), which makes F1 sensitive to individual misclassifications.
blocks.zh: 每个地点的宏观平均AUC在0.94至0.96之间,95%的置信间隔重叠,每个机构都有三个年级的代表(表4)。 准确性在各地点之间没有显著差异(Baylor 71%,Mayo 87%,OHSU 86%,UAB 89%;Fisher准确的p=0.34),也没有为真实类别分配预测概率(Kruskal-Wallis H=2.82,p=0.42)。 Baylor的下层F1 (0.68;95% CI 0.44,0.88)反映了小站点样本(n=21,只有3个HGD病例),这使得F1对个别分类错误敏感.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: This study demonstrates that a foundation model-based approach can grade Barrett’s esophagus dysplasia across four institutions without the institution-specific stain normalization required by prior deep learning systems. Using stain-robust pretrained representations, the model achieved a macro-averaged AUC of 0.96 and 98% sensitivity for dysplasia detection, with a negative likelihood ratio of 0.030 that reduces post-test probability from a reported index-endoscopy dysplasia prevalence of 13% to 17% to below 1% [ 24 , 25 ] . Agreement with expert consensus was strong (quadratic-weighted κ \kappa = 0.83), performance did not differ significantly across the four contributing institutions (p = 0.34), and the error pattern favored clinical safety: 85% of misclassifications involved adjacent grades, 70% were overcalls rather than undercalls, and no high-grade dysplasia case was misclassified as non-dysplastic.
blocks.zh: 这项研究表明,基于基础的模型方法可以将巴雷特的食道分级到四个机构,而无需按照以往深层学习系统的要求实现机构特有的污点正常化。 该模型使用污渍活性预受训练的表示方式,实现了宏观平均AUC为0.96和98%的分辨性,负概率比为0.030,将测试后概率从所报指数-内分泌活性血压流行率为13%至17%降至1%以下[24,25]. 与专家共识达成的协议很强(quadratic-quighted $\kappa = 0.83),四个贡献机构的表现没有显著差别(p = 0.34),错误模式有利于临床安全:85%的分类错误涉及相邻的年级,70%是高分而不是低分,没有高分分分级的德累累症病例被错误地归类为非德累累症。

blocks.en: Inter-observer variability in dysplasia grading remains a persistent clinical challenge, with expert agreement particularly poor for low-grade dysplasia ( κ \kappa = 0.42) [ 10 ] and community pathologists demonstrating lower concordance still, alongside a well-documented tendency toward overdiagnosis [ 10 , 12 ] . Difficult cases are typically referred to expert gastrointestinal pathologists for confirmation, but subspecialty expertise is not uniformly available, particularly in community practice. A negative model prediction leaves the probability of dysplasia below 1.5% across the range of prevalences plausible in Barrett’s esophagus populations, low enough to support continued routine surveillance. Because the model assigns a grade rather than a binary label and detected high-grade dysplasia with 89% sensitivity, cases most likely to require eradication therapy can be prioritized for expert confirmation, which remains necessary because the distinction between low- and high-grade dysplasia determines management. The model’s per-class agreement for low-grade dysplasia ( κ \kappa = 0.72; 95% CI 0.58, 0.83) compares favorably with published inter-pathologist agreement for this grade ( κ \kappa = 0.11–0.43) [ 10 , 11 , 26 ] , although direct comparison requires caution: published values reflect independent reads without adjudication and derive from cohorts with differing case mix, whereas our model was evaluated against adjudicated consensus labels on a class-balanced test set.
blocks.zh: 血压分级的观测者间可变性仍然是持续的临床挑战,对于低等血压分级(\kappa = 0.42)[10] 和社区病理学家表现出较低的一致性,专家意见尤其差,同时存在有据可查的过度诊断趋势[10,12]。 困难案例通常提交胃肠道病理学专家确认,但亚专业专业知识并不统一,特别是在社区实践中. 在巴雷特的食道人群中,负面的模型预测使得发作概率低于1.5 % , 足以支持持续的常规监控。 由于该模型指定了分级而不是二进制标签,并检测出89%灵敏度高的分级干燥症,因此最可能需要根除疗法的病例可以优先供专家确认,这仍然有必要,因为低等和高等干燥症的区分决定了管理. 尽管直接比较需要谨慎:所公布的数值反映的是独立阅读,并且来自不同案例的组合,而我们的模型则根据在分类平衡测试集上裁定的协商一致标签来评价。

blocks.en: The clinical consequence of misclassification depends on its direction. Overcalling to low-grade dysplasia (6 cases) risks unnecessary surveillance intensification or ablation consideration, and overcalling to high-grade dysplasia (8 cases) risks the procedure itself, with real cost, procedural risk, and patient anxiety that should not be minimized. Undercalling high-grade as low-grade dysplasia (4 cases) would substitute surveillance for ablation, potentially delaying treatment and permitting interval progression. Two low-grade dysplasia cases were called non-dysplastic. Because low-grade dysplasia carries lower short-term progression risk than high-grade disease and would in most cases be detected on subsequent surveillance biopsy, the consequence is less severe than a missed high-grade lesion, though not negligible given that low-grade dysplasia is precisely the grade for which the model is intended to add value. These error frequencies reflect the test set class distribution, which does not represent real-world surveillance populations where non-dysplastic Barrett’s esophagus predominates; the absolute frequency of overcalls would likely be higher in clinical practice. The complete absence of high-grade-to-non-dysplastic misclassification remains the most important safety finding, as no patient with advanced neoplasia would have been falsely reassured and placed on an extended surveillance interval. While overtreatment carries real costs, missed high-grade dysplasia risks irreversible progression to cancer, making unnecessary intervention the more acceptable failure mode in this setting.
blocks.zh: 错误分类的临床后果取决于其方向. 过度提及低级症候群(6个病例)有不必要的监视强化或膨胀考虑的风险,过度提及高级症候群(8个病例)有风险该程序本身,其实际成本,程序风险和病人焦虑不应被降到最低. 将高级称为低级干燥症(4个病例)将取代监测,从而可能推迟治疗,并允许间隔。 两个低级的德累斯普拉西亚病例被称为"非德累斯". 由于同高等疾病相比,低级呼吸道疾病具有较低的短期发展风险,而且在大多数情况下,在后续的监控活检中都会被检测出,因此其后果不如错失的高等病变严重,但考虑到低级呼吸道疾病恰恰是该模型打算增加价值的级别,因此并非可以忽略不计。 这些误差频率反映了测试集的分级分布,这并不代表现实世界的监视人群,其中非障碍巴雷特的食道占主导地位;在临床实践中,超调的绝对频率可能更高. 完全没有高等级至非低级的错分类仍然是最重要的安全发现,因为任何患有高级新血症的病人都不会被错误地保证,并被置于延长的监视间隔上. 虽然过度治疗带来实际成本,但错过了高等级的发作有不可逆转地发展到癌症的危险,使得不必要的干预成为这种环境下更可接受的失败模式.

blocks.en: Our group previously developed a two-stage system combining YOLO object detection with ResNet101 classification, achieving greater than 90% sensitivity and specificity on 542 Mayo Clinic slides [ 13 ] . External validation across three academic centers [ 15 ] confirmed generalizability but required cycle-GAN stain normalization to accommodate inter-institutional staining differences, a step that limits scalability in routine practice. The current study extends this work with a larger multi-institutional training dataset (969 versus 542 slides), a foundation model backbone with built-in stain robustness, removal of the stain normalization requirement, and dysplasia detection sensitivity improving to 98%. Botros et al. developed a system using 290 slides from Amsterdam UMC, achieving AUC 0.94 for distinguishing non-dysplastic Barrett’s esophagus from any dysplasia with 92% sensitivity and 94% specificity, benchmarked against 55 pathologists [ 14 ] . Our study differs primarily in employing multi-institutional training with a foundation model backbone, whereas Botros et al. focused on single-center development with extensive pathologist benchmarking. Collectively these studies establish the feasibility of deep learning for Barrett’s esophagus dysplasia grading while highlighting the limitations of single-center development and institution-specific preprocessing [ 17 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们集团此前开发了将YOLO对象检测与ResNet101分类相结合的两相系统,在542个"Mayo Clinic"幻灯片上实现了超过90%的敏感性和特异性. [13]. 三个学术中心的外部验证[15]确认可通用性,但需要循环-GAN污渍正常化,以适应机构间的污渍差异,这一步骤限制了例行实践中的可扩展性。 目前的研究将这项工作扩展为更大的多机构培训数据集(969对542个幻灯片),基础模型主干线具有内在的污点坚固性,去除污点正常化要求,并有血压检测敏感性提高到98%. 博特罗斯等. 使用来自阿姆斯特丹UMC的290个幻灯片开发了一套系统,实现了AUC 0.94,将非塑性巴雷特的食道与任何有92%敏感性和94%特异性,以55名病理学家为基准[14]。 我们的研究主要在利用多机构培训方面有所不同,这种培训具有基础模型骨干,而Botros等人则侧重于单中心发展,并有广泛的病理学家基准。 这些研究共同确定了深入学习巴雷特食道干燥分级的可行性,同时突出了单中心发展和机构特定预处理的局限性[17,27].

blocks.en: Midnight-12k is trained with hue-saturation-density augmentation, exposing the encoder to staining variation during pretraining, and reaches benchmark performance comparable to larger foundation models despite far less pretraining data [ 22 ] . Augmentation of this kind is common across current pathology foundation models [ 18 ] , so these results speak to the class of stain-robust representations rather than to this backbone specifically. The two-stage design balances annotation efficiency against interpretability: Stage 1 classifiers identify diagnostically relevant tissue before Stage 2 aggregation, reducing false-positive classification of artifacts and non-glandular tissue as dysplasia, while AttriMIL’s class-specific attention maps allow pathologists to review which regions drove each prediction, supporting clinical oversight rather than black-box deployment. Requiring patch-level annotations from only a single institution while performing consistently across four centers reduces the expert labeling burden that constrains most pathology artificial intelligence systems, consistent with emerging evidence that foundation model features enable few-shot generalization [ 17 ] . Training data were also markedly unbalanced across sites: Mayo Clinic contributed 531 slides, while the other three centers contributed 118 to 169 each. Performance nonetheless remained consistent across institutions (p = 0.34). A model relying on staining or scanning characteristics specific to the dominant center would be expected to underperform at the three smaller sites, and none did.
blocks.zh: Midnight-12k接受过"Hue-饱和-密度增强"的训练,使编码器在预训期间暴露出有污点变异,并且达到基准性能可以与较大的基础模型相比,尽管预训数据要少得多[22]. 这种增强在目前病理基础模型中是常见的[18],因此这些结果讲的是污渍-活性表示的类别,而不是这个主干. 两级设计兼顾说明效率和可解释性: 第1阶段分类器在第2阶段集合前确定诊断相关的组织,减少将文物和非腺组织错误的分级为干燥性;而AttriMIL的班级关注图则允许病理学家审查哪个地区驱动了每个预测,支持临床监督而不是黑箱部署. 仅仅从一个机构要求补丁级说明,同时在四个中心之间一致地进行,这减轻了限制大多数病理人工智能系统的专家标签负担,这符合新出现的证据,即基础模型特征能够使几发一般化[17]。 各个地点的培训数据也明显不平衡: 马约诊所提供了531个幻灯片,而其他三个中心各提供了118至169个幻灯片。 尽管如此,各机构的业绩仍然一致(p=0.34)。 依靠主要中心特有的污迹或扫描特征的模型,预计在三个较小的站点会表现不佳,没有任何一个站点没有。

blocks.en: Several limitations qualify these findings. The retrospective design may introduce slide selection bias, and the near-balanced class distribution of the dataset does not reflect surveillance populations, which affects the absolute error frequencies reported above and the positive predictive value achievable in practice. We assessed slide-level classification rather than patient-level outcomes, and the clinically decisive question, whether algorithmic grading predicts progression to adenocarcinoma, requires longitudinal follow-up unavailable in this dataset. Head-to-head comparison against other contemporary foundation models such as UNI [ 17 ] , Virchow [ 27 ] , or CONCH [ 28 ] was not performed, and ablation studies isolating the contribution of individual architectural components were not conducted; comparable benchmark performance across foundation model backbones in multiple instance learning pipelines [ 29 ] suggests similar results would be obtainable, but this remains untested here. Geographic restriction to four United States centers limits conclusions about institutions using different tissue processing and staining protocols.
blocks.zh: 有几个限制使这些调查结果具有了一定的局限性。 追溯设计可能引入幻灯片选择偏差,数据集的近平分类分布并不反映监视群,这影响了上文所报的绝对出错频率以及实际可实现的正预测值. 我们评估了滑行级的分类,而不是病人级的结果,临床上的决定性问题,即算法分级是否预测到腺癌,需要本数据集无法提供的纵向跟踪。 与UNI[17],Virchow [27],或CONCH[28]等当代其他地基模型的正面对面比较没有进行,没有进行隔离单个建筑构件贡献的消融研究;在多例学习管道中,不同地基模型主干线的可比基准性能[29]表明可以取得类似的结果,但这一点在这里仍然没有经过测试. 对四个美国中心的地理限制限制了关于机构使用不同组织处理和污渍协议的结论。

blocks.en: Ongoing companion studies address several of these limitations directly: a prospective evaluation of model performance on 450 community-sourced low-grade dysplasia cases will assess real-world generalizability in the population where overcalling is most prevalent and where grade distribution most closely resembles the general Barrett’s esophagus population, and a multi-reader multi-case study examining the effect of artificial-intelligence-assisted reading on pathologist performance is underway. Validation in independent international cohorts and patient-level outcome linkage would further establish clinical validity beyond diagnostic accuracy, while uncertainty quantification providing case-specific confidence scores would enable more nuanced decision support. Extension to other gastrointestinal dysplasia contexts, such as gastric intestinal metaplasia or colorectal dysplasia, would test the broader applicability of this approach. Taken together, these results indicate that foundation model-based deep learning can grade Barrett’s esophagus dysplasia consistently across four institutions without stain normalization, offering clinically meaningful rule-out capability with a conservative error profile, and that annotations from a single center suffice to reach this performance, a combination that suggests a practical pathway toward scalable deployment of artificial-intelligence-assisted dysplasia grading.
blocks.zh: 正在进行的伴行研究直接解决了其中的几个局限性:对450个社区来源的低等血压病例的模型性能进行预测性评价,将评估在高调现象最普遍、级别分布与普通巴雷特人食道最相近的人群中,现实世界的普遍性;目前正在进行一项多读多科研究,审查人工智能辅助阅读对病理学表现的影响。 在独立的国际群体中进行验证和病人一级的结果联系,将进一步确立临床有效性,超越诊断准确性,而提供具体案例信任分数的不确定性量化则能够提供更细致的决定支持。 推广到其他胃肠道干燥上下文,如胃肠道干燥或内分泌干燥等,将检验这种方法的更广泛适用性. 这些结果表明,基于基础模型的深入学习可以在没有污点正常化的情况下在四个机构中对巴雷特的食道障碍进行一致的分级,提供临床上有意义的规则排除能力,同时提供保守的错误剖面,而单一中心的说明足以达到这一性能,这种综合说明为可扩展地部署人工智能辅助的痢疾分级提供了切实可行的途径。

blocks.en: Note on interpretation of attention overlays (Figures S1–S6)
blocks.zh: 关于解释注意表的说明(图S1-S6)

blocks.en: Pathologist annotations shown in these figures indicate regions confirmed to contain tissue of the slide’s final diagnostic grade. They were not intended as exhaustive delineations of all such tissue on the slide: annotators marked a representative subset of qualifying regions (median 3 per slide, range 1–28), and additional regions of the same grade may be present but unmarked. Each whole slide image also contains several tissue sections cut at different levels from the same specimen, so a lesion annotated on one section is frequently present on adjacent sections without having been separately annotated.
blocks.zh: 这些数字中显示的病理学家说明表明经证实含有幻灯片最后诊断分级的组织的区域。 它们并不是要对幻灯片上的所有此类组织进行详尽的划分:注释员标出合格区域的代表性子集(中间为每张幻灯片3个,范围为1至28个),可能还有其他同级区域,但没有标记。 每个整体的幻灯片图像还包含从同一份标本中切出不同水平的多个组织部分,因此一个部分上附加注释的损伤经常出现在相邻部分上而未单独附加注释.

blocks.en: Attention overlays should therefore be read asymmetrically. Overlap between high-scoring patches and annotated regions is positive evidence that the model attended to diagnostically relevant tissue. High-scoring patches falling outside annotated regions do not by themselves indicate that the model attended to irrelevant tissue, since those areas may contain unannotated tissue of the same grade, or the corresponding region of an adjacent section.
blocks.zh: 因此,应当对注意力的重叠进行不对称的解读。 高分补丁和注解区域之间的重叠是该模型用于诊断相关组织的积极证据。 位于注解区域以外的高分补丁本身并不表明模型被处理到无关的组织,因为这些区域可能含有同级的无注解组织,或相邻部分的相应区域.
